conflicts.permit: Such activities may involve the disclosure of your personal information to third parties and may be considered a “sale” of data under certain (but not all) data protection laws.
conflicts.prohibit: Honeywell does not sell your personal information to third parties for profit.
conflicts.situation: When personal information is disclosed to third parties for monetary or valuable consideration (profit) under data protection laws.
conflicts.reason: The policy flatly denies selling personal information for profit, but immediately acknowledges engaging in activities that constitute a sale of personal information to third parties.
